source: Community-sourced from MLB.com, ESPN, USA Today, Dodgers Nation, Dodgers Blue, Braves reporting, LAFB Network, Fox Sports, SI, Tournaments.com

current_injury.details: Suffered a non-displaced fracture of the left fibula during Spring Training 2026. Missed virtually the entire 2025 season and into early 2026. On the 60-day injured list while rehabbing. This is his first injury-shortened season since 2023.

injury_history.details: Non-displaced fracture sustained in Spring Training. Currently on 60-day IL rehabbing.
Strained the medial collateral ligament in his left knee during a game. Missed time but returned.
Torn meniscus requiring surgery. Faced long-term concerns about his clutch-play dominance returning.
Bone bruise and contusion to the left knee. Missed time but recovered.

current_injury.type: Right wrist soreness + Stiff lower back
current_injury.details: Right wrist soreness caused a late scratch vs. A's (July 2026). Treatment improved symptoms; expected to return next game. Additionally, stiff lower back causing consecutive game misses (out 3+ games as of July 13). NOT expected to be placed on IL.

injury_history.type: Right wrist soreness + Stiff lower back
injury_history.details: Wrist soreness caused lineup scratch vs. A's. Lower back stiffness causing game misses. Day-to-day status not expected on IL. Dave Roberts: 'He's feeling a little better.'
Broken right wrist during batting practice in a freak spring training accident at Camelback Ranch. Struck by a deflected ball from a pitching machine. Sidelined 6-8 weeks.
Strain caused lineup removal and a stint on the injured list. Dave Roberts gave optimistic update as treatment improved symptoms.
Severe illness causing significant weight loss (nearly 20 lbs in two weeks). Also dealt with death of stepfather.

current_injury.details: Managing chronic left ankle with occasional flare-ups. No acute injury at this time. Previous neck stinger from August 2025 has fully resolved. Previous right ankle had debridement surgery in December 2024 with full recovery.

injury_history.details: Late scratch from lineup vs. Cincinnati Reds. Short-lived, returned quickly.
Left ankle managed with treatment and occasional load management. Not a full absence from lineup.
Ongoing neck management reported by Dodgers coaching staff after August stinger.
Sprained right ankle late in regular season. Underwent debridement and removal of loose bodies in early December 2024. Played through injury in 2024 postseason. Won World Series MVP.

metadata.contribution_guidelines: Fork repository, create feature branch, update injury-updates.json and/or LATEST-INFO.md, submit PR with date, details, rehab timeline, return status, and source URL.
